# 757 Gas Shop — LLM Context File
> Built by Zoth Studio Team | https://nullai.tech

## Overview
757 Gas Shop is a full-stack e-commerce Progressive Web App (PWA) serving the Hampton Roads / Virginia Beach 757 area. The application features a live product menu, age-gated access, real-time order tracking, and cryptocurrency payment integration via Solana (Phantom Wallet) and CashApp.

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS 4, React Router 7, Zustand, Motion (Framer Motion), Lucide Icons
- **Backend**: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Realtime), Netlify Functions, Express.js
- **Payments**: Solana Web3.js + SPL Token, Phantom Wallet SDK, Stripe, CashApp
- **Maps**: Leaflet + React-Leaflet for location-based pickup
- **AI**: Google GenAI SDK integration
- **SEO**: React Helmet Async, Schema.org JSON-LD

## Key Features
- Age verification gate with localStorage persistence
- Live product catalog with detail pages and cart management
- Solana crypto wallet integration (Phantom browser SDK)
- Real-time order status tracking
- User profile and order history
- Support ticketing system
- Dark/light theme with premium glassmorphism UI
- Responsive PWA with offline capabilities
